limitations: Proved only in the border-containment case and for 1632 individual relations; 527 small relations remain open (infinite completions).
novelty_basis: Two web searches (2026-10-18) found no general formula; related literature - Nyberg-Brodda survey of one-relation monoids (arXiv:2105.02853), "Relations on words" (arXiv:1602.03364), Kudryavtseva 2010. Needs a deeper search (Hilbert series of one-relator algebras - Anick, Piontkovski, Iyudu).
statement:
For all words u != v of equal length k over a q-letter alphabet, the number of congruence classes of
length-n words modulo u = v has generating function c(x) / (x^k + (1 - q x) c(x)), where
c(x) = 1 + sum over words b that are borders of both u and v of x^(k - |b|).
title: Common-border conjecture: one-relation class counts depend only on common borders
